THE RULES ARE SIMPLE

A race from A to Z.

  1. Gather around a screen and spin the dials. The category settles first, then the start letter, then the end letter.
  2. Find a word beginning with the orange letter and ending with the green one, in the purple category. S + T + Nature = sunset.
  3. Shout it! The first valid word wins. Settle ties together, then spin again.

Agree your house rules first: we suggest real English words, at least two letters, and no names. Keep score out loud if you like.

Keep a favourite

Tap any dial to lock its result while the others spin; tap it again to unlock. Unlock at least one dial to play. Friendly mode finds a word that fits the locks; if none is in our list, unlock a dial or choose All letters.

Make it your game

Friendly pairs always have an example word in the chosen category. All letters can give you impossible combinations — just spin again. Switch on the 30-second timer for a little pressure. In Friendly pairs, an answer pops up when time runs out and the next round spins by itself.

Take it offline

Open this game online once and it saves itself for offline play. Then you can reopen it without a connection. Add it to your home screen from your browser’s menu for easy access.
